Messages.Author: Santiago
Messages.Body:
I checked the list of rules clarifications, but I couldn't find
this there: Is a minion in a round of combat required to make a strike?
As the rules read, it seems that, if no other strikes are available from
cards, a minion MUST declare a hand strike; standing around doing
nothing is mentioned nowhere. This matters in some situations, such as
against a Blood of Acid.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <santiago-8CC2ED...@newshost.cc.utexas.edu>,
Santiago <sant...@nastyPinkCannedMeat.cs.utexas.edu> writes

>Is a minion in a round of combat required to make a strike?

Yes.

Specific card text (e.g. Hidden Lurker) is required to over-ride this.
In all cases, a minion must either strike for hands or use some other
source of strike.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
>
> In message <santiago-8CC2ED...@newshost.cc.utexas.edu>,
> Santiago <sant...@nastyPinkCannedMeat.cs.utexas.edu> writes
> >Is a minion in a round of combat required to make a strike?
>
> Yes.
>
> Specific card text (e.g. Hidden Lurker) is required to over-ride this.
> In all cases, a minion must either strike for hands or use some other
> source of strike.

Correct. Section 6.4.3 detail choosing a strike, and says that the default
action the the "choose strike" phase is a hand strike. You need some
explicit text (card/effect) to change the default.
